title: Large Family with Newborn Baby, Living Room - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A warm group portrait of a large American family gathered together in an indoor living room setting, captured in October 1963. The mother wears cat-eye glasses and holds a newborn baby in her arms, seated beside the smiling father with a toddler in his lap. Surrounded by their five other children of varying ages—some seated on the floor and others standing or leaning behind—the family smiles towards the camera. Patterned curtains and a small wall decoration furnish the mid-century suburban home background.
